digest.component_or_area: Cloud comment dedup and outbound fitting
propositions: The dedup comparison key (via sanitizer.fit_comment at 32767 chars) and the Cloud send path (via AdfCodec.fit_outbound at 32000 serialized bytes) apply different truncation rules, so body-equality dedup never matches for over-length comments.
For a 40000-char input, the dedup key yields 32767 chars but the landed body is 31753 chars due to marker budget and ADF serialization, causing first divergence at index 31725.
The divergence was introduced by commit 27b868ba55 (emersed-specific-mutt), which moved the send path off the shared truncate_comment_body helper while leaving the differ on it.
Over-length comments skip dedup and re-post on every pass because the primary id-based skip depends on a potentially lost map write between add_comment and record_comment_id.
The fix restores identical fitting by composing fit_comment_as_sent with the ADF codec in _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment, ensuring the differ and send path use the same truncation logic.
The dedup key is never persisted, so no migration is needed; the new key matches every case where the old key matched the landed body, only adding skips, never removing them.
